run_sine_policy: run the minitaur gym environment with a sine gait walking policy using --env 0
run_sine_stand: run the minitaur gym environment with a sine stand and squat example using --env 1
run_reset_pose: run the minitaur gym environment standing still in the reset pose using --env 2
run_motor_overheat: run the minitaur gym environment to trigger motor overheat protection using --env 3
review_writetocsv: review the WriteToCSV function that saves simulation actions and observations to a CSV file
